Google India Team Share x.com Facebook Linkedin Mail Copy link Today at Google I/O Connect India 2025, we celebrated the incredible momentum of AI adoption and leadership by India’s startups and developers. It’s been deeply encouraging to see that many have chosen our Gemini, Gemma and GenMedia models to power their AI journeys. The Indian startup and developer ecosystem has used capabilities available through Google AI Studio, Cloud and Vertex AI for India’s scale and diversity, building faster, smarter, and efficiently. And at I/O Connect, eight startups showcased applications built with Google’s powerful AI models, facilitating real-world impact across sectors - from education and governance to commerce and media. Sarvam is working to help build a sovereign AI ecosystem for India that caters to the country’s wide-ranging culture and diversity. Sarvam has been selected for the INDIAai Mission to contribute to India’s Sovereign AI. Sarvam has used Gemma 3 to build its recently-released translation model, Sarvam-Translate , an open-source model delivering accurate, context-rich translations for long-form across all 22 officially-recognized Indian languages. Gemma 3's efficiency and industry-leading native multilingual understanding enabled Sarvam to lower the costs of training and inferencing for Indian languages, supporting Sarvam-Translate in providing high-quality, culturally-nuanced translations. As a hosted translation API, the model has been serving over 100,000 weekly translation requests. This API is also a key component of Samvaad, the organization’s conversational AI agent platform, which has handled over 10 million conversation turns across Indian languages. CoRover supports businesses in building customizable multilingual customer chatbots that are powered by Gemini. Gemini supports chatbots’ communication in over 100 languages with near 99 percent accuracy. CoRover ’s solutions, including BharatGPT that supports organizations with flexible AI models, have supported over 1 billion users, over 25,000 enterprises and developers, and over 20 billion interactions. The deployment of Gemini as part of the Google Cloud AI Stack has supported the organization in improving operational efficiency by up to 70 percent, increasing its speed in implementing solutions by 10x, while also maintaining and growing customer satisfaction. Glance is an AI-native platform that merges deep commerce intelligence with hyper-real visual shopping. Powered by Gemini and Imagen via Vertex AI, Glance delivers personalized experiences that turn everyday surfaces into dynamic hubs for discovery and commerce.
